title: Even High School Boys Have Their Holes… / Ume Takes Responsibility
overview: Ume Mizunoe joins the student council so he doesn't have to repeat a year, but everyone there has such unique personalities. He nervously starts working there and gets thrown around by the council's strong personalities!

title: Savior Tan / The Seven Mysteries of the Academy and the Council’s Night Patrol / Komaro Is Here!
overview: Ume drops by the student council room as he takes care of something early in the morning. He then finds a young girl covered in blood slumped over a desk! And it seems the girl has become quite attached to Ume!?
